# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **GPU rendering and error recovery**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 integrates Skia m158 fixes for GPU failures, image filtering and glyph rendering. The collected native update preserves managed APIs, generated bindings and dependency versions.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Ganesh flush failure handling** — Propagates low-level draw and upload failures and abandons the context when recovery is unsafe. Failed promise-image fulfillment drops the flush's work but remains nonfatal, leaving the context usable. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **Imagination GPU failure safeguards** — Rejects oversized multisample attachments on affected Imagination GL, ANGLE and Vulkan devices. Ganesh and Graphite deliberately abandon Vulkan descriptor pools after affected out-of-memory errors rather than destroy them unsafely; Graphite rejects further allocations through a null pool handle. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **Image filtering and draw order** — Ganesh prevents unwritten scratch texels from entering filtered images through mipmaps and clips destination reads to their bounds. Graphite resets depth after full-overwrite draws to preserve painter order. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **FreeType glyph bounds** — Corrects LCD16 bitmap bounds conversion and cropping when font scalers return different bounds between glyph loads. Bitmap validation and outline-translation checks also guard image buffer bounds. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))

## Security

- **Overflow-safe Ganesh allocations** — Checks buffer alignment, padding and element-size arithmetic, rejects invalid sizes, allows CPU buffer allocation to fail safely, and caps block and vertex-chunk allocations. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
